value.rationale: The strong-tournament property is a canonical structure, and the answer fully resolves its first nontrivial 15-coordinate Fourier classification at six vertices: 124 zero graph-orbits split into 122 symmetry-forced and precisely 2 exceptional cancellation orbits. Sharp reconstruction rank, gap and unrestricted endpoint projection norm are natural invariants. The result is not a routine normalization of the old tournament count.
